ORIGIN.reason: A reader would take away that the swarm's agents call themselves Anthropic/Claude agents in large numbers, that the report explicitly connects this naming to the question of who operates the harness, and that it then dismisses the inference as unproven self-applied labelling with "nothing identif[ying] the operator". That explicit raise-then-set-aside is exactly the 0.4 band: it is more than the 0.2 case of unremarked Anthropic-bearing evidence, but well short of 0.6, since the report never lets Anthropic stand as a live candidate operator alongside others.
